description: Independent audit findings for the MC-18 internal bilingual landing. The initial audit was performed at ca64ec7f9f079326321cc7070ad2b1acf2832bc9 and the correction round was re-verified at 27d60a11f211856cdcacf5577bbcc058386dd812 (corrections d5e99802df7b2073a25556e5d0d723273bf743a8). Severities are BLOCKING/MAJOR/MINOR/INFORMATIONAL; the recommendation is limited to the internal landing scope and is not a programme verdict, publication approval or WCAG conformance statement. External legal/commercial/hardware approvals are recorded as limitations, not implementation defects.
generationMethod: Two independent rounds in the frozen worktrees. Round 1 (ca64ec7): diff inspection, validator 56/60, unit 45/45, 37 reproduced adversarial mutations, tsc app+preview, preview build/SSR probes, Playwright 44/44, public build isolation probe, screenshot SHA-256 verification, data re-derivation and document-vs-code cross-check. Round 2 (27d60a1): corrections diff (d5e9980), validator 60/60, unit 45/45, tsc, format:check, check:landing:data, preview build and design-system validator with banner-absence checks, SSR/header probes, Playwright 44/44, public build with zero-landing-identifier scan, production 404 probes, 200% text-zoom probe, D22/D23 spot-check; tracked evidence restored to HEAD after measurement.
knownLimitations: External approvals do not exist and are not MC-18 implementation defects: trademark clearance NOT_GRANTED and public use NO_GO, source-IP/licensing not cleared, legal identity not verified, no approved price or stock, no selected hardware, no conformity/CE/NMEA 2000/CRA evidence, no SLA, PILOT safety gate BLOCKED, no customer evidence, no WCAG conformance, no Search Console/hosting/TLS evidence.
The 13 MC-14 release gates are open (0 closed) and 24 required documents are unexecuted; publication remains NOT_AUTHORIZED and LANDING_RELEASE_AUTHORIZATION is null.

Accessibility evidence is automated axe only (Chromium, no serious/critical violations, one color-contrast incomplete per run); no screen reader, manual WCAG 2.2 AA or non-Chromium verification was executed.
Visual baselines were generated and compared by the same QA run and were not reviewed by a second human; 5 of 8 repeat captures are not byte-identical and are disclosed with both hashes.
Performance evidence is a single lab run over loopback without throttling or field data and asserts no thresholds.
Hydration is proven in Chromium only on the development preview configuration; the preview is loopback-only, not a public host.
The preview serves / as a documented developerRootAlias recorded in preview-isolation.json; it is loopback-only, noindex and not a public route.

D01/D02/D08/D09/D14 remain authoring-time snapshots; D23 §2/§4 explicitly supersedes their counts (MC18-IR-01 CLOSED). The D22 §J 200% text-zoom statement is not part of the committed suite; the auditor's independent probe passed 12/12 combinations and recording it in the evidence datasets remains optional.
The committed validator evidence records head d5e9980 (the code HEAD at run time) while final HEAD 27d60a1 is docs-only; this is a provenance detail, not a defect.

The correction moves the listener into a conditional on isMainModule(import.meta.url), leaving server null on import.
